subject.title: [Bug]: Fallback model does not report progress correctly during long tasks

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee user-visible intermediate progress parity across model fallback candidates, including cross-provider fallbacks?
rationale: Source shows the plumbing exists, but the documented product contract currently covers fallback notices rather than all intermediate progress signals, and a repair path depends on whether parity is mandatory or degraded progress is acceptable for some providers.

options.title: Guarantee fallback progress parity
options.body: Treat missing intermediate progress during fallback as a core bug and require tests plus live proof that fallback attempts preserve the same channel-visible progress signals as primary attempts.

options.title: Document degraded fallback progress
options.body: Allow some fallback providers to complete work with reduced intermediate progress and document the limitation with a visible user-facing warning.

options.title: Fold into broader fallback delivery work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the durable fallback delivery semantics effort and solve intermediate progress together with final-message fallback guarantees.

recommendation.title: Guarantee fallback progress parity
recommendation.body: Treat missing intermediate progress during fallback as a core bug and require tests plus live proof that fallback attempts preserve the same channel-visible progress signals as primary attempts.
